insight: Formed when Czech TMS Memsource acquired German rival Phrase (ex-PhraseApp) in 2021 and took its name in a 2022 rebrand.
name: Phrase
tagline: AI-powered localization platform unifying TMS, software strings, and machine translation.
description: Phrase is an enterprise localization platform that automates, manages, and delivers multilingual content. It bundles a translation management system (Phrase TMS), developer-facing string localization (Phrase Strings), workflow automation (Orchestrator), and Phrase Language AI, which routes each job to the best-fitting machine translation engine and scores output quality before release. Plans scale from individual freelancers to custom enterprise contracts.

modelSupport.notes: Phrase Language AI routes content across multiple MT engines and applies AI quality estimation.

edge: A full localization suite — TMS, strings, MT orchestration, and quality scoring in one platform — rather than a point translation tool.
pros: TMS, strings, and MT in one suite
Auto-selects the best MT engine per job

references.title: Memsource and Phrase Announce a New Joint Identity and Localization Suite
